scope: Exploratory saved-trace decoder intervention; no compression, backbone calls or TEST evaluation

fit.loss: per-output observed TRAIN sum SSE plus lambda times squared RMS-scaled coefficients
fit.residual_target: observed target minus current frozen TSFM forecast
fit.feature_scaling: TRAIN-only RMS using rows with at least one observed target; fold-local TRAIN RMS within CV
fit.precision: feature/statistics/coefficient FP64; readout branch FP32; residual output adds original FP32 forecast
fit.tie_break: earliest index in fixed ascending lambda grid

selection.primary: earliest minimum VAL observed channel-macro MSE; repeated exploratory development VAL
selection.secondary: earliest minimum equally weighted mean of three TRAIN chronological fold channel-macro MSEs; refit on all TRAIN
selection.cv_scope_caveat: Conditional decoder CV: saved forecasts and targets retain parent full-TRAIN normalization. Fold-local readout fits/scales have no heldout-target use, but this is not a fully nested end-to-end rolling backtest.
selection.arm_choice: Report every arm; no automatic final-family selection or claim of independent generalization

cv.heldout_rule: origin >= cut[j] and origin + horizon <= cut[j+1]
cv.purge: No overlapping future target timestamp between fit and heldout; historical context may overlap and remains legitimately available

diagnostic_hypotheses: H1: zero-centered shrinkage distorts raw forecast level under TRAIN-to-VAL mean changes; equal-capacity identity-centered ridge tests this mechanism
H2: unrestricted cross-channel readout worsens generalization; full/diagonal crossed with both ridge centers tests capacity effects
H3: lag features worsen generalization; full residual D8 vs D0 tests lag capacity jointly with changed feature dimension
H4: constant-level/DC preservation helps; lag-minus-current residual constrains summed temporal gains to identity, with changed dimension and penalty geometry
diagnostics: error excess = correction energy - 2 times correction/residual alignment
per-channel mean-bias squared vs centered error variance
non-overlapping alternate VAL origin subsets as descriptive sensitivity
claims: Robin-only mechanism sensitivity on fixed forecasts, not a new decoder novelty claim, compressor benefit, LEVEL improvement, independent TEST result or full E/F/D speed measurement
